scope: Prospective evidence only; immutable source context, no computation, physical procedure, scientific acceptance or remote action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Current versus retired and historical source state
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Fittings, torsion straps and retired skin; docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md costed-budget architecture caveat
entries.method: Request the source revision and architecture label associated with each prospective interface record.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A retired structural-skin line or historical sealed-cell barrier does not define the current schematic film interface.

entries.existing_model_reference: docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md Film, close-up fittings and outfit
entries.method: Request matched drawing revision, article and installed assembly identity, including omissions and unresolved boundaries.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The film is a schematic drape, not a measured membrane; a mesh depiction does not identify installed seams or attachments.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Membrane edge, seal, bond and seam provenance
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Fittings, torsion straps and retired skin
entries.method: Request separately identified edge, seam, seal, coating and bond records with material/geometry provenance and calibration custody, without selecting any.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The complete-bill question asks which items belong; no measured interface, material, bond or adopted inclusion is supplied here.

entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Fittings, torsion straps and retired skin; docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md outfit
entries.method: Request attachment-to-equipment and membrane/frame boundary identity, with inclusion/exclusion and actual configuration records.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Outfit context does not establish installed attachment hardware, interface ownership or completeness; person/wrap context is not an added member.

entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Fittings, torsion straps and retired skin
entries.method: Request revision-matched inclusion/exclusion records and unresolved item custody, retaining omissions and failed applicability.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A schematic or retired skin allowance cannot silently become a complete current interface inventory; no allowance or hardware is chosen.

entries.existing_model_reference: docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md Film, close-up fittings and outfit; docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md architecture caveat
entries.method: Request separately recorded applicability, uncertainty/calibration provenance, owner and criterion adoption tied to the same current interface.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Observed geometry, material/bond performance, owner, applicability and adopted criterion remain absent; physical acceptance is UNKNOWN.
